document: HomeGuard Privacy Platform — Testing & QA Specification

frameworks.e2e: Playwright Test Runner (@playwright/test) — full-stack E2E against running Docker Compose stack
frameworks.database: PostgreSQL via testcontainers-python (real DB, not SQLite)
frameworks.test_doubles: Fake Playwright service (FastAPI), aiosmtpd (fake SMTP), imaplib mock for IMAP
frameworks.e2e_package: @playwright/test — separate from playwright python package used by the playwright service

design_decisions.frameworks: pytest for all Python (API, Celery tasks, Mailwatcher, executor logic) + Vitest for React (components, hooks, stores) + Playwright Test Runner for E2E flows against the live Docker Compose stack
design_decisions.database: testcontainers-python spins up real PostgreSQL per test session — pgcrypto and UUID functions work correctly
design_decisions.test_doubles: Fake Playwright FastAPI service returns structured JobResult JSON. aiosmtpd provides real SMTP server in-process. IMAP mocked via unittest.mock.
design_decisions.quality_gates: Coverage targets (80% line) + named critical path tests that must all pass for a green build

pg_container.description: Starts PostgreSQL 15 testcontainer once per test session. Runs Alembic migrations. Tears down after all tests.
pg_container.implementation: from testcontainers.postgres import PostgresContainer; container = PostgresContainer('postgres:15-alpine'); container.start()

db_session.description: Async SQLAlchemy session per test. Wraps each test in a transaction that rolls back on teardown — tests never persist state to each other.
db_session.implementation: async with engine.begin() as conn: await conn.run_sync(lambda c: c.execute('SAVEPOINT test_sp')); yield session; await conn.run_sync(lambda c: c.execute('ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT test_sp'))

test_client.description: FastAPI TestClient with DB session overridden to use test transaction session
test_client.implementation: app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = lambda: db_session; client = AsyncClient(app=app, base_url='http://test')

critical_paths.description: These test cases must ALL pass for a build to be considered green, regardless of coverage percentage

paths.name: Authentication gate
paths.rationale: If auth is broken the entire system is either locked out or wide open

paths.name: Scan detects and triggers removal
paths.rationale: Core value proposition — scan finds data, removal request dispatched

paths.name: Email confirmed removal triggers verification
paths.rationale: Removal lifecycle must close the loop with independent verification

paths.name: Re-listing detected and re-acted upon
paths.rationale: Re-listing detection is a core differentiator — must always work

paths.name: Follow-up escalation works
paths.rationale: Prevents requests silently stalling forever without human awareness

paths.name: Webhook authentication enforced
paths.rationale: Unsigned webhook must be rejected — prevents registry poisoning

paths.name: PII encryption round-trip
paths.rationale: PII must be unreadable in DB without key — foundational privacy guarantee

paths.name: Audit log append-only
paths.rationale: Compliance record integrity — must be provably tamper-resistant

paths.name: Email classification correctness
paths.rationale: Misclassification causes wrong status updates — high-stakes correctness

paths.name: Frontend auth never touches localStorage
paths.rationale: JWT in localStorage is a known XSS attack vector — must never happen

paths.name: Onboarding wizard end-to-end
paths.rationale: First-run experience must work perfectly — broken onboarding blocks all usage

paths.name: Scan progress live update
tests: manual scan shows live progress and populates results
paths.rationale: SSE + WebSocket real-time updates are core UX — must work in a real browser

paths.name: Notification WebSocket push
tests: notification bell updates on new exposure
paths.rationale: Live notification delivery via WebSocket must work end-to-end in real browser

available_factories.make_profile: Creates profile with encrypted PII fields. Params: name, num_addresses, num_phones, is_paused.
available_factories.make_broker: Creates broker with playbook. Params: category, removal_method, captcha_required, is_active.
available_factories.make_scan_run: Creates completed scan run with results. Params: num_found, num_not_found, num_errors.
available_factories.make_removal_request: Creates request at specified status. Params: status, followup_count, method.
available_factories.make_exposure: Creates active or resolved exposure. Params: is_active, fields_detected.
available_factories.make_audit_log_entry: Creates audit log entry. Params: event_type, outcome.
available_factories.household_fixture: Creates complete household — 2 profiles, 10 brokers, mixed scan results and requests.

e2e_test_infrastructure.description: Playwright Test Runner executes E2E tests against a fully running Docker Compose test stack

test_stack_setup.description: E2E tests run against a dedicated test Docker Compose stack with seeded data
differences_from_prod: Uses separate named volumes (homeguard_test_db_data etc.) — never touches production data
SCAN_SCHEDULE_CRON=disabled — no automatic scans during E2E run
SMTP/IMAP pointed at local aiosmtpd test server
Playwright proxy URL pointed at fake broker server
Pre-seeded with 2 test profiles and 20 test brokers via init script
test_stack_setup.before_all_hook: global-setup.ts verifies stack health via /api/system/health before any test runs
test_stack_setup.after_all_hook: global-teardown.ts resets DB to seed state via docker compose exec db psql reset script

auth_fixture.description: Logs in once, saves browser storage state to file. All E2E tests reuse saved auth state — no repeated login flows.

fake_broker_server.description: Lightweight HTTP server that mimics broker opt-out pages for E2E testing. Playwright executor scans against this server instead of real broker sites.

endpoints.GET /captcha: Returns page with .g-recaptcha element (for captcha detection E2E test)
